stories.title: Authors wary of content ownership despite court ruling on Anthropic case
stories.summary: The literary world is celebrating Anthropic's $1.5 billion settlement with authors. But AI firms may still train models on legally purchased books. What does that mean?

stories.title: Pentagon changes how it releases casualty data as Iran conflict continues
stories.summary: As U.S. service member deaths and injuries from Iranian attacks increased last week, the Pentagon shifted how it releases information on casualties.

stories.title: How San Diego Comic-Con has changed over the years
stories.summary: Comic Con International 2026 wrapped up Sunday night. We discuss the weekend's biggest announcements and the ways that the convention is evolving.

stories.title: Arizona, California face big cuts in anticipated new Colorado River rules
stories.summary: The federal government has decided how to divide the Colorado River among the seven states that share it. Climate-driven drought has made an already contentious process even more difficult.

stories.title: Haitians face an uncertain future as TPS ends
stories.summary: More than 300,000 Haitians living in the United States are losing Temporary Protected Status. Many now face an uncertain legal future and possible deportation.

stories.title: Georgia's Okefenokee Swamp becomes a UNESCO World Heritage site
stories.summary: The Okefenokee Swamp in Georgia has joined the list of UNESCO World Heritage sites.
